messages:
Priya: Uploaded a one-pager draft 'Shield Slate' 1: security + SLA + deployment choices. Need tech check + CTA pick. doc: https://docs.google.com/d/xyz789
Ethan: Nice layout. Two asks: add a tiny benchmark callout and one line on graceful degradation/fallbacks.
Lena: I can wire inbound so any form that checks 'SLA required' auto-attaches the PDF and flags on-prem as high-touch.
Ethan: Draft benchmark blurb: 'p95 latency ~150ms for common gen; hosted unit est ~$0.02/1k tokens. Dedicated can cut unit cost ~40% at sustained util.' Keep it short.
Priya: Great. Can you also drop a 20s webinar talking point to use on a slide?
Ethan: 20s line: 'Teams need predictable latency, clear SLAs, and secure network controls. Redwood offers a unified runtime with VPC/on-prem options, proven p95s, and automatic fallbacks to keep apps online during upgrades.'
Lena: Routing pseudo-config (simple):
- if form.field('SLA required') OR lead.tag == 'enterprise' -> attach Shield-Slate.pdf, assign enterprise-ops, priority=P1
- if form.request contains 'on-prem' -> assign solutions-engineer, notify security@redwood.com
- else -> growth-sdr
Lena: Also adding SDR note template: "Lead requests SLA scoping; attach Shield Slate; propose 30m scoping call."
Priya: CTA candidates: 'Download Shield Slate: SLAs & secure deployment checklist' (primary gated) or 'Request a quick SLA scoping call' (follow-up for high-touch). I prefer the first.
Ethan: Microcopy for button: 'Download: Shield Slate (1 page)'  keeps friction low.
Lena: For webinar follow-up: include the brief + a benchmark card image (one stat + 1-line benefit). I'll file an art request.
Priya: Action items: Ethan -> paste benchmark + 20s line into doc; Lena -> push routing & SDR auto-attach; Priya -> finalize CTA and publish. Target: Fri 4pm PT.
Ethan: Done 1: added benchmark/line, ETA 2pm.
Lena: Routing pushed to playbook, SDR auto-attach created, ETA 3:30pm.
Priya: Will finalize CTAs and schedule webinar/growth promotion.
OpsBot: Calendar event 'Shield Slate launch review' Friday 10:00 AM  invite sent to Priya, Ethan, Lena."
